about: Outside adds from a lone waypoint patroller arriving mid-pull. Shadow Labyrinth Malicious Instructor 146200 is a native MovementType-2 patroller with no formation (path 1462000, 11 points). Its loop circles the Cabal formation 146080 (target, pred 5 obs 5 in tr-20260922-201412-47#9) and runs along x -241, 5yd from that run's real tank start. So it can walk into the camp naturally about 15-20s after staging, and the swept injection makes it engage the healer at a chosen phase and delay. Run sweep=all for the phase x delay heat-map. 'x' cells are windows where the pull loses the add (O1), wedges (O6) or loses someone (O10); 'U' cells are windows it absorbs. Same failure class live: UK Dragonflayer Overseer patrol 125976 joined the 3-mob Strategist pull in tr-20260922-191117-19#22 and tr-20260922-185328-8#23. That geometry was not used because staging resets the Overseer 15yd from the party.
